candidates.name: The Chokepoint
candidates.rationale: Explains how concentrated fertilizer/feedstock trade turns a maritime disruption into differentiated global input pressure.

candidates.name: The Buffer
candidates.rationale: Follows how an import-dependent food system uses finance, procurement, stocks and allocation to prevent exposure becoming shortage.

candidates.name: The Farm Gate
candidates.rationale: Would follow whether national availability translates into timely, affordable access and changed fertilizer use for smallholders.

candidates.name: The Plate
candidates.rationale: Would follow fertilizer pressure into food prices and household food security.

candidates.name: The Alternate Route
candidates.rationale: Uses Australia as a comparator showing supplier diversification, targeted risk support and supply recovery under the same global shock.
